integrity: The complete proof is analytic; the standalone exact rational enumerator and algebraic checker provide corroborating but finite evidence. Historical priority remains subject to independent literature review.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotics require deterministic complete tripartite part sizes with strictly positive proportional limits and uniform feasible-edge selection; no finite-order universal bound, four-or-more-part theorem, weighted-edge extension or central limit theorem is asserted.
title: The sharp \(7/8\) random-edge matching ratio on dense complete tripartite graphs
